limitations: Only fixed c in (0,1) with arclength-uniform boundary sampling.
Weak convergence and limiting-law phase behavior, not uniform finite-N error rates or finite-sample statistical guarantees.
Historically complete novelty and independent external verification are not established.
scientific_integrity: The stated theorem is justified by a joint endpoint-gap limit and explicit local Euclidean expansion. Reproducibility code supplies finite checks but is not used as an infinite proof. The equilateral c=1 limit is excluded and earlier work on its exact fixed-shape distribution is credited.
title: A critical diameter crossover for nearly isosceles triangle boundaries
